title: codehelion scan report
description: Machine-readable result of one codehelion scan. A change that breaks field compatibility increments schema_version and ships a new schema document; purely additive fields keep the version.

groups.description: Every detected clone group, suppressed ones included, ordered by priority descending with the fingerprint as a tie-break.

root.description: Absolute path of the scanned directory.

database.description: Path of the audit database the snapshot was recorded in.

run_id.description: Row id of the recorded scan run.

headers.description: Language bare .h headers were read as. Absent when the run enumerated neither C nor C++.

unparsed.description: Tokens the parser could not attach to any structure. Absent in Fast mode, which lexes and does not parse.

files.description: Files holding at least one such token.

tokens.description: How many such tokens there are, excluding what error recovery salvaged.

share.description: Those tokens as a share of every analysed token.

excluded.description: Files the scan dropped, by cause; nothing is omitted silently.

type_3.description: Gapped groups; zero in modes that report no gapped clones.

fragment_scope.description: How many of the total describe a run duplicated inside units that are not clones of each other; zero in modes that only compare whole units.

folded_runs.description: Duplicated runs left out of the listing because a reported whole-unit group already covers them, so the fold is visible rather than silent.

subsumed_runs.description: Duplicated runs left out because a longer run covers every one of their occurrences and classifies at least as strictly.

test_code.description: How many of the total live wholly in a test suite; zero in modes that cannot read the test marker.

unused_suppressions.description: Configured suppression rules that hid nothing in this run. A rule matching nothing reads as an instruction that took effect while the findings it was meant to cover are still reported, so it is named rather than left to be found by accident.

funnel.description: How many items each stage of the candidate pipeline passed on, in run order. A scan finds duplication by narrowing, so without the intermediate counts a run that found nothing looks like a run whose filters threw the evidence away. Stage names differ between the scan modes, and the structural run forks after candidate extraction into whole-unit verification and sub-unit run consolidation, so the list is a record of what happened rather than one arithmetic chain.

passed.description: Items handed to the next stage.

dropped.description: Items the stage dropped, by cause; a cause that dropped nothing is left out.

cause.description: Why the items were dropped, as a snake_case cause.

split_components.description: Sets of related units too large to compare as one piece, which grouping cut so its cost stays bounded. Every reported group is still cohesive; what the cut costs is the chance that two members on opposite sides of it would have been reported together.

pair_budget_exhausted.description: True when the candidate-pair budget ran out and results may be incomplete.

scope.description: What each member is: a whole duplicated unit, or a run of statements duplicated inside units that need not be clones of each other.

statements.description: Statements each member covers, for fragment-scope groups; null for unit-scope groups, whose extent is the unit itself.

confidence.description: Minimum pairwise similarity across the group.

similarity.description: Null in modes that match content exactly and score no dimensions.

boilerplate.description: The boilerplate shape every member matches; null when they do not all match one.

test_code.description: Whether every member is test code, recognised from the test marker in the source. False for a group spanning a test and the code it exercises: that duplication crosses the boundary.

split_pair.description: Whether this is a verified pair reported on its own because no group could hold both members. Being a clone is not transitive, so a unit can be a copy of two units that are not copies of each other, and only one such relation fits in a group. These are the only findings whose members also appear in other findings.

suppressed.description: Null when the group is visible in default reports.

priority.description: The ranking value together with the inputs it was computed from; the collapsed number never replaces them.

similarity.description: Per-dimension similarity evidence. Every dimension stays visible; the composite never replaces the breakdown, and an unavailable dimension is null rather than a guessed number.

weight_version.description: Composite-weight recipe the group was scored under.

api.description: Null when neither unit calls anything, so the dimension had nothing to compare.

composite.description: Weighted mean of the measured dimensions.

min_pairwise.description: Weakest pairwise similarity inside the group: its cohesion.

reason.description: Engine noise category, present when kind is noise.

scope.description: Suppression-rule scope, present when kind is rule.

pattern.description: Suppression-rule pattern, present when kind is rule.

file.description: Path relative to the scan root.

unit.description: Name of the enclosing unit, when anchored to one.
